content.short: Payoneer is a global payments platform with multi-currency receiving accounts, mass payouts and cards.
content.description: Payoneer, founded in 2005, is a global payments platform that helps freelancers, online sellers and businesses get paid across borders and manage money in multiple currencies. It provides receiving accounts with local bank details in currencies like USD, EUR and GBP, letting users collect payments from marketplaces such as Amazon and Upwork, pay suppliers and VAT, run mass payouts and spend with commercial cards. Payoneer targets the global gig economy, e-commerce merchants and SMEs that trade internationally and need to move money between platforms, contractors and banks without expensive wires. By combining multi-currency accounts, marketplace integrations and cards, it works as a widely used hub for cross-border commerce.
content.meta: Payoneer offers global receiving accounts, mass payouts and cards for businesses. Discover Payoneer and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
